create_Tracker_instance: create a Tracker instance with a config dict containing dataset_path, Calibration, and scene_exposure_gain keys
get_single_data_camera: get a single Camera object from the Tracker by calling get_single_data to process the next frame
get_data_multiprocess: retrieve the next Camera object from the multiprocessing queue buffer via the Tracker get_data method
get_vignette_correction: retrieve the vignette correction numpy array from the Tracker using the get_vignette property
get_sample_camera: get the sample Camera object from the Tracker by calling the get_sample_cam method
